filesystem_scan.scope: scripts/file_sorter.py scan may read directory entries under an absolute --root. It must not follow symlinks or write files except an optional --output JSON.
filesystem_scan.reason: A review plan needs an inventory of the target folder.

target_enforcement.openai: Permission metadata only; the host must authorize directory reads.
target_enforcement.claude: Bash may run the helper; scan remains non-mutating aside from optional JSON output.
target_enforcement.generic: Permission metadata for downstream host enforcement.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust is not authorization to scan arbitrary disks.

filesystem_move.scope: apply --execute may mkdir destination folders under scan_root and shutil.move planned items when ok_to_apply is true and identity checks pass.
filesystem_move.reason: Approved plans need a deterministic mover. Default apply is dry-run.

target_enforcement.openai: Permission metadata only; the host must require this-turn plan_id approval before --execute.
target_enforcement.claude: Bash may run the helper; SKILL forbids --execute without this-turn approval.
target_enforcement.generic: Permission metadata for downstream host enforcement.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust is not authorization to move files.

filesystem_undo.scope: undo --execute may move sidecar destinations back to recorded sources when size matches and the source path is free. It must not delete or overwrite.
filesystem_undo.reason: Completed apply entries need a reversible sidecar.

target_enforcement.openai: Permission metadata only; undo --execute needs this-turn approval of the sidecar.
target_enforcement.claude: Bash may run the helper; SKILL forbids --execute without approval.
target_enforcement.generic: Permission metadata for downstream host enforcement.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust is not authorization to undo moves.
